newsitem.title: NIGERIA: NIGERIA SUSPENDS 12 BLN NAIRA GRANT TO NNPC - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: NIGERIA SUSPENDS 12 BLN NAIRA GRANT TO NNPC - PAPER.

text.p: Nigeria's finance ministry has suspended a 12 billion naira ($145 million) grant to Nigerian National Petroleum Corp (NNPC) which would be used to repair ailing refineries, a local newspaper said on Friday.

The independent Vanguard newspaper quoted a senior official at the petroleum ministry as saying: "We have words from the office of the accountant-general that the finance ministry has cancelled the release."
Petroleum minister Dan Etete on Wednesday said the ministry had received money from the finance ministry which would be used for turnaround maintenance of the refineries.
"It was unclear what informed the sudden action of the finance minister," the Vanguard said.
Etete and finance minister Anthony Ani publicly criticised each other last month over the release of funds to the oil industry.
Lack of funds and maintenance have taken their toll on Nigeria's refineries which have a combined capacity of 445,000 barrels per day of crude oil.
Shortages force Nigeria to import fuel despite the fact that it pumps over two million bpd of crude oil.
